title: CORE-7143 · SHARED: testimonial quote text too light — #595959 vs live #555555
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7143](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7143) · **PR** #114

Premise verified. **Correct.** Source-of-truth page `/company-dissolution` @1440, Cookiebot accepted and
fixed/sticky `z-index > 10` overlays stripped.

| element | live | clone before |
|---|---|---|
| **quote body** (`p.Testimonials--testimonial__comment`) | **`rgb(85, 85, 85)`** | `rgb(89, 89, 89)` |
| author | `rgb(89, 89, 89)` | matches |
| brand | `rgb(89, 89, 89)` | matches |
| wrapper div | `rgb(54, 54, 54)` | — the wrapper trap, not the quote colour |

Corroborated breakpoint-independently in the live stylesheet: `.Testimonials--testimonial__comment{color:#555}`
is declared once, unconditionally, and is the **only** `color:#555` in the entire 301 KB bundle. The
author/brand rules declare no colour and inherit `#595959`.

## The change

`TestimonialQuote.styles.ts:14` pointed `comment` at `--text-on-light-muted` (`rgb(89 89 89)`). No token
held `rgb(85 85 85)`. Added `--text-on-light-quote: rgb(85 85 85)` and re-pointed only the `comment` class.

**The shared token's value was NOT changed** — it has **88** consumer sites across `src/`. Precedent for a
one-off token exists in the same block (`--text-on-light-title`, 1 consumer).

## After

1440 and 390 both compute `rgb(85, 85, 85)`, with font-size/weight/line-height already matching live.
Regression probe on the same rendered page confirms an unrelated `--text-on-light-muted` consumer still
computes `rgb(89,89,89)`; `--text-on-light-quote` has exactly one consumer.

No screenshots: a 4-unit grey delta does not survive a screenshot — the computed values are the evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Quote body computes rgb(85, 85, 85) on a production build, matching live.
Author, brand and icon colours unchanged.
--text-on-light-muted value untouched; its 88 other consumers unaffected.
Merges cleanly with the CORE-7121 branch (Component.tsx not touched).
